turns.text: Whoa, Alex, there are a lot of questions there, right?
turns.zh: 哇，Alex，那里问题好多啊，对吧？

turns.text: But on test day, it actually goes pretty quickly.
turns.zh: 但考试那天，其实过得挺快的。

turns.text: Time really flies on test day you'll find that.
turns.zh: 考试那天时间真的飞逝，你会发现的。

turns.text: So how do you think you went answering those questions?
turns.zh: 那你觉得你那些问题答得怎么样？
